title: Pre-trained materials models screen high-entropy alloys for hardness and conductivity
summary: The TSPPES strategy lets models pre-trained on universal materials databases generalize to high-entropy alloys without additional training data, and with multi-objective optimization screens over 10^6 compositions across 60 metals. Two W-Re-based families were identified, including as-cast W28.63Re14.50Ta28.18Zr14.21Nb14.47 (801 +/- 9 HV, 18.00 W/m/K at 300 K) and an FCC alloy with 816 +/- 49 HV and about 20% equivalent ductility. Only a few alloys were tested and the abstract gives no prediction-versus-measurement errors for them.
ai_technology: TSPPES prediction enhancement for models pre-trained on universal materials databases, with multi-objective optimization

evidence.tested: Synthesis and measurement of hardness, thermal conductivity and ductility of selected alloys.
evidence.unknown: Prediction errors for the new alloys and broader validity; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Pre-trained property models screened compositions to select the alloys.
